Crash.type: Compiler crash (Clang front end, during IR generation)
Crash.explanation: Omitting typename on a dependent nested alias used as a return type crashes Clang 19.1.0 while instantiating the function, even on an assertions-off build.

reproduce.expected: The file compiles successfully (it is valid C++20).
reproduce.observed: The compiler crashes with a stack dump while generating IR for the instantiated function (ASTContext::getTypeInfoImpl reaches an undeduced auto type).

Crash.type: Compiler crash (Clang front end, segmentation fault)
Crash.explanation: A function-local static variable bound to a reference non-type template parameter segfaults Clang 19.1.0 during instantiation.

reproduce.observed: Segmentation fault (the front end queries constant-size-type info on a dependent type).

Crash.type: Compiler crash (Clang front end, segmentation fault in return-type deduction)
Crash.explanation: A trailing return type that instantiates a constant-wrapper template segfaults Clang 19.1.0 in auto return-type deduction.

reproduce.observed: Segmentation fault: return-type deduction (DeduceAutoType) dereferences a null type pointer while instantiating the constant wrapper in the trailing return type.

Crash.type: Compiler crash (Clang front end, deduction-guide instantiation)
Crash.explanation: A deduction guide on an inner class template with a parameter-pack outer template crashes Clang 19.1.0 during instantiation, at any optimization level.

reproduce.observed: The compiler crashes with a stack dump while instantiating the inner class template’s deduction guide (at any optimization level, -O0 through -O3).

Miscompilation.type: Miscompilation (generated program crashes at runtime, -O1 only)
Miscompilation.explanation: Clang 19.1.0 -O1 mis-compiles this switch/loop program so the binary segfaults; -O0/-O2/-O3 are correct and the source is UBSan-clean.

reproduce.expected: Correct behavior: the program simply returns (exit 0). This is what the -O0, -O2 and -O3 builds do, and the source is free of undefined behavior (UBSan-clean at -O0).
reproduce.observed: Only the -O1 build is affected: the resulting binary dies with SIGSEGV right at start (exit 139).

Miscompilation.type: Miscompilation (x86-64 backend: shift+mask equality compiled as a non-equivalent rotate)
Miscompilation.explanation: Clang 19.1.0 for x86-64 compiles (x << 2) == (x & -4) on a 3-bit integer as a rotate comparison, giving wrong answers for 2 of 8 inputs at -O1/-O2 (-O0 is correct); an IR-level reproducer is included.

reproduce.environment: Clang 19.1.0 (x86-64-unknown-linux-gnu); llc 19.1.0 for the IR-level reproducer
reproduce.command: clang -O1 test11.c -o a.out && ./a.out   # also -O2; IR level: llc -mtriple=x86_64-linux-gnu -filetype=obj test11.ll && link test11_driver.c
reproduce.expected: Every input a in 0..7 must yield f(a<<8) per the reference table {1,3,1,3,3,1,3,1} (the -O0 build prints "RESULT: correct").
reproduce.observed: -O1/-O2 builds print "RESULT: wrong": inputs a=2 and a=5 return 3 instead of 1. The generated code compares X against rotl(X, 2) instead of evaluating (X << 2) == (X & -4) on the 3-bit value; the two forms differ whenever the shift amount does not divide the bit width. The same wrong fold is visible when test11.ll is compiled with llc for x86-64.

Miscompilation.type: Miscompilation (SLP vectorizer narrows a comparison; silent wrong value)
Miscompilation.explanation: Clang 19.1.0 -O2/-O3 SLP-vectorizes an unsigned-short comparison as a signed 16-bit compare, silently printing acc=1 instead of acc=9; -O0/-O1 are correct.

reproduce.expected: The program prints "acc=9 (expected 9)" (as the -O0 and -O1 builds do).
reproduce.observed: The -O2/-O3 builds print "acc=1 (expected 9)". No crash — the value is silently wrong.

Crash.type: Compiler crash (segmentation fault in nested-function lowering)
Crash.explanation: Two nested functions inside one function, the first carrying a section attribute, crash GCC 14.3.0 during nested-function lowering at -O1/-O2; -O0 compiles cleanly.

reproduce.expected: The file compiles successfully (as it does at -O0).
reproduce.observed:
internal compiler error: Segmentation fault
The crash happens while lowering the nested functions (tree-nested.cc). The same crash occurs at -O2.

Crash.type: Compiler crash (internal error in the C front end)
Crash.explanation: A ternary expression mixing a _Float16 value with an integer logical negation aborts the C front end at any optimization level.

reproduce.observed:
internal compiler error: in build_conditional_expr, at c/c-typeck.cc:5720
Reproduces at every optimization level (-O0/-O1/-O2/-O3).

Crash.type: Compiler crash (internal error in constant folding, C++ front end)
Crash.explanation: A pointer conversion inside a constexpr context aborts the C++ front end during constant folding, at any optimization level.

reproduce.observed:
internal compiler error: in fold_convert_loc, at fold-const.cc:2757
Reproduces at every optimization level (-O0/-O1/-O2/-O3).

Crash.type: Compiler crash (internal error during C++ template instantiation)
Crash.explanation: Nested local structs whose default member initializer uses sizeof of a function-local static constexpr array crash GCC 14.3.0 while the enclosing template is instantiated, at -O0 and -O2.

reproduce.observed:
internal compiler error: in enclosing_instantiation_of, at cp/pt.cc:15184
Reproduces at -O0 and -O2.

Miscompilation.type: Miscompilation (wrong control-flow merge; the generated binary crashes at runtime)
Miscompilation.explanation: With asm goto + a thread_local memory input + a noreturn branch, GCC 14.3.0 -O1/-O2 emits code whose labels merge before the prologue; the binary segfaults, while -O0 is correct and the source is UBSan-clean.

reproduce.expected: The program runs to completion: the "abort path" call returns false and main exits 0 (observed with -O0, and with other compilers).
reproduce.observed: With -O1 or -O2 the generated binary segfaults on the second call: the abort label is emitted merged with the early-return label before the prologue, so `ret` pops a local variable instead of the return address.
